figures.caption: An office mezzanine is a structural and circulation project: load path, deck, stairs, guardrails, support bases, utilities, and office enclosure all need to be resolved as one package.
figures.before: Why a Mezzanine Is the Right Answer for Most Warehouses

figures.alt: Commercial planning workspace with plans, laptop, hardhat, and estimating tools
figures.caption: Coordinate code, structural support, stairs, utilities, office layout, and permits as one package. A mezzanine adds multiple scopes that need to be resolved before fabrication.

figures.alt: Warehouse floor condition inspected with a laser level and straightedge
figures.caption: Review the slab and base conditions where new supports, equipment, and partitions may land. The office build-out has to respect the industrial floor and operating environment below it.
